dossier.scp_unleashed.093.title: Red Sea Object
dossier.scp_unleashed.093.caption: Photograph recovered from SCP-093-1. Note the figure at left.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-093 is kept in a locked storage container in a room with no mirrors. It may be removed only for approved exploration of SCP-093-1.
**Exploration teams are to note the mirror they leave by and keep it guarded until they return.**
Any liquid recovered from SCP-093-1 is to be sealed, logged and stored. It is not to be tasted.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-093 is a flat disc of dark red stone, about twelve centimetres across and cut with twenty sides. A thin black ring is set into it near the edge, and its face is covered in small black figures: people with outstretched arms, a falling figure, spirals, waves and marks like combs or ladders.

Set into the slot of a mirror, SCP-093 turns the glass a swirling amber and the mirror begins to hum. Personnel who then touch the glass find themselves in SCP-093-1, a hazy amber plain of dry grass and bare earth. It is dotted with abandoned shacks and, more rarely, the ruins of small towns. No living person has been met there.

SCP-093-2 instances are pale torsos more than eight metres tall, with no lower body. They hang in the air and drag themselves along on enormous arms, and the ground shakes each time a hand comes down. Their heads are smooth, with a cluster of holes where a face should be. %rThey do not need to see you.%r

page.title: Addendum 093-1: Exploration
text: Every team that crossed over arrived beside a weathered empty frame standing in the grass, and left the same way.
Team 4's mirror was moved while they were inside. %rThey came back anyway, but not to the room they had left.%r

page.title: Addendum 093-2: Recovered Vials
text: Small vials of amber liquid have been found in the ruins, though very rarely. Subjects who drank one reported visions of the plain and of the figures that walk it.
One subject was given several over a single afternoon. %rThe recording runs on for some minutes after he stops moving.%r

item.scp_unleashed.scp093_disc.tooltip: A heavy disc of dark red stone, cut with small black figures.
item.scp_unleashed.scp093_disc.seat: Fits the round slot at the top of a standing mirror
item.scp_unleashed.scp093_disc.take: Sneak-use the mirror with an empty hand to lift it out again
item.scp_unleashed.scp093_disc.store: Can be kept in a storage container
item.scp_unleashed.scp093_tears.tooltip: A stoppered glass vial. The liquid inside gives off a faint amber light.
item.scp_unleashed.scp093_tears.feed: Use it on a D-Class to have them drink it
item.scp_unleashed.scp093_tears.warning: Its effects linger and build on one another

message.scp_unleashed.scp093.no_dimensio: The glass stays dark. SCP-093-1 is missing from this world's data.
message.scp_unleashed.scp093.way_closed: The way back has closed. You wake somewhere familiar.
message.scp_unleashed.scp093.mirror_here: The glass shows nothing but the plain.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_disc.1: SCP-093 is a flat disc of dark red stone, ringed near its edge and covered in small black figures.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_disc.2: Seat it in the slot of a Standing Mirror, then use the mirror. Sneak-use the mirror with an empty hand to take the disc back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_disc.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-093 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress delivers it a few minutes later, with a mirror.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_mirror.1: A two-block Standing Mirror. Its crown has a round, empty slot.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_mirror.2: On its own it is only a mirror.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_tears.1: A vial of amber liquid, found very rarely in the ruins on the far side of the glass.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_tears.2: Drinking it brings visions. Use it on a D-Class to have them drink it instead.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_tears.3: Its effects linger and build on one another.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp093_torso_spaw: SCP-093-2: a pale torso more than eight metres tall that hovers over the ground and drags itself along on enormous arms. Its face is a cluster of holes.
%s health. Hostile to people. Every time a hand comes down, the ground shakes. Slow, but it does not give up.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp093.0: The courier is the same figure noted in other files.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp093.1: The disc comes with a mirror. Keep that mirror somewhere safe.
